title: Cat looks stunned as mom tries a TikTok trend with dramatic singing
description:
Some bonds are made of cuddles and tuna treats.

Others are tested by Taylor Swift at full volume.

Chrysa shared this dramatic moment where her cat faced the ultimate challenge of surviving a human trying a TikTok trend right in his face.

Singing Taylor Swift's song 'Ready For It?' with full-body energy, Chrysa gave her pet a live concert he never signed up for.

As her voice hit the chorus, the cat's soul quietly left the room.

His confusion was real, and his fear was deeper.
